function.name: calculate_mortgage_payment
function.description: Calculate the monthly mortgage payment given the loan amount, annual interest rate, and number of years. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

loan_amount.description: The loan amount. This is a float type value.

annual_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. This is a float type value.

years.description: Number of years the mortgage is amortized over.

message.content: I don’t have access to live market data, so I can’t tell you the exact rate at this moment. Mortgage rates vary by lender, loan type (fixed vs. adjustable), credit score, down‑payment size, and other factors. If you let me know which kind of mortgage you’re looking at (e.g., 30‑year fixed, 15‑year fixed, FHA, VA, etc.) and any details about your situation (credit score range, down‑payment %, etc.), I can give you an estimate based on recent averages and then help you calculate a monthly payment using that estimate.
